selection_before_model_evaluation: ArnetMiner component of S2AND selected for its small size, independently curated author clusters, publication years and public distribution. No performance-based source selection has occurred.
license_reported_by_authors: ODC-BY for data; inspect the distribution license before redistribution.
potential_use: A bounded externally curated identity-fragmentation application on timestamped publication records; no artificial alias fragmentation would be needed if the observed signatures are treated as separate mentions.
critical_boundaries: Author disambiguation is a different application from business event-log repair. It does not validate naturally occurring wrong loan/order associations.
Individual author mentions are natural records, but treating each mention as a distinct graph handle is an explicit representation choice, not evidence that a source system stored a wrong identity.
Ground-truth clusters must never be used to construct predictor-visible coauthor entities, features, or candidate blocks.
Reference authorship labels can be incomplete or imperfect; use only the declared curated component and document exclusions.
A dedicated published author-disambiguation method is required before making a competitive claim on this application.
A negative or incompatible feasibility finding will be retained; it will not be relabelled as successful natural-error validation.
decision: Inspect schema, independent label provenance, temporal coverage and observation compatibility before deciding whether this belongs in the paper. Keep main revision focused on operational histories.
